_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units、unit-texts.json 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 受到训练后的露丝契亚掠食者，听从号令向敌阵发起凶猛的突击。
desc.en: Trained predators from Lustria, unleashed at a command to crash into the enemy ranks.

story.zh: 冷蜥是栖息在露丝契亚阴暗雨林深处的残忍掠食者。这些动物不知痛楚，唯有血腥气味能点燃它们盲目的杀戮欲望，在野外几乎无法被真正驾驭。殷翎曾从露丝契亚带回了大量的冷蜥并且驯养。与野生的同类不同，受到严格操练的冷蜥在战场上听从号令、进退有度，但在被放出冲锋时，依然保留着原始而致命的残暴撕咬。
story.en: Cold Ones are vicious predators that dwell deep within the dark rainforests of Lustria. Insensible to pain, they are driven to blind slaughter by the scent of blood, and their wild kind are almost impossible to control. Yin Ling brought many back from Lustria and had them trained. Unlike their feral kin, these rigorously drilled beasts obey commands and advance or withdraw in good order. Once unleashed in a charge, however, their savage bites remain as deadly as ever.

desc.zh: 在压力之下，生存本能支配了这些天生的捕食者，从而大大增加了他们的战斗潜力
desc.en: When under pressure, the primal instincts of these natural predators take over, improving their potential in combat.

desc.zh: 凶猛的掠食战士们一心一意地履行自己的职责，他们敏锐的感官会驱使他们追猎自己的猎物
desc.en: Ferocious predator-warriors are so single-minded in their duties and their heightened senses drive them to pursue their quarry.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
